# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Layout
      # Checks if empty lines exist around the bodies of methods.
      #
      # @example
      #
      #   # good
      #
      #   def foo
      #     # ...
      #   end
      #
      #   # bad
      #
      #   def bar
      #
      #     # ...
      #
      #   end
      class EmptyLinesAroundMethodBody < Base
        include EmptyLinesAroundBody
        extend AutoCorrector

        KIND = 'method'

        def on_def(node)
          return if node.single_line?

          investigation = processed_source
          return unless investigation

          source_lines = investigation.lines
          return if source_lines.nil? || source_lines.empty?

          method_range = node.source_range
          return unless method_range

          first_line = method_range.first_line
          last_line = method_range.last_line
          return unless first_line.positive?
          return if last_line < first_line

          window_start = first_line
          window_end = last_line
          signature_last_line = first_line
          method_body = node.body
          method_arguments = node.arguments
          method_location = node.loc
          method_expression = method_location.expression if method_location
          expression_first_line = method_expression.line if method_expression
          signature_last_line = [signature_last_line, expression_first_line].max if expression_first_line

          if node.defs_type?
            receiver_node = node.receiver
            if receiver_node
              receiver_range = receiver_node.source_range
              if receiver_range
                receiver_first_line = receiver_range.first_line
                receiver_last_line = receiver_range.last_line
                receiver_span = receiver_last_line - receiver_first_line
                receiver_span_end = receiver_first_line + receiver_span
                window_start = [window_start, receiver_first_line].min
                signature_last_line = [signature_last_line, receiver_span_end].max
              end
            end
          end

          end_location = method_location.end if method_location
          if end_location
            end_keyword_line = end_location.line
            window_end = [window_end, end_keyword_line].max
          end

          if method_location
            name_location = method_location.name
            if name_location
              name_line = name_location.line
              signature_last_line = [signature_last_line, name_line].max
            end
          end

          if method_arguments
            arguments_range = method_arguments.source_range
            if arguments_range
              arguments_first_line = arguments_range.first_line
              arguments_last_line = arguments_range.last_line
              arguments_span = arguments_last_line - arguments_first_line
              arguments_span_end = arguments_first_line + arguments_span
              window_start = [window_start, arguments_first_line].min
              signature_last_line = [signature_last_line, arguments_span_end].max
              window_end = [window_end, arguments_span_end].max
            end

            method_arguments.children.each do |argument|
              next unless argument

              argument_range = argument.source_range if argument.respond_to?(:source_range)
              if argument_range
                argument_first_line = argument_range.first_line
                argument_last_line = argument_range.last_line
                argument_span = argument_last_line - argument_first_line
                argument_span_end = argument_first_line + argument_span
                signature_last_line = [signature_last_line, argument_span_end].max
                window_start = [window_start, argument_first_line].min
                window_end = [window_end, argument_span_end].max
              end

              case argument.type
              when :optarg
                default_value = argument.default_value
                if default_value
                  default_range = default_value.source_range
                  if default_range
                    default_first_line = default_range.first_line
                    default_last_line = default_range.last_line
                    signature_last_line = [signature_last_line, default_last_line].max
                    window_end = [window_end, default_last_line].max
                    window_start = [window_start, default_first_line].min
                  end
                end
              when :kwoptarg
                default_value = argument.default_value
                if default_value
                  default_range = default_value.source_range
                  if default_range
                    default_first_line = default_range.first_line
                    default_last_line = default_range.last_line
                    signature_last_line = [signature_last_line, default_last_line].max
                    window_end = [window_end, default_last_line].max
                    window_start = [window_start, default_first_line].min
                  end
                end
              when :mlhs
                argument.children.each do |nested_argument|
                  next unless nested_argument

                  nested_range = nested_argument.source_range
                  if nested_range
                    nested_last_line = nested_range.last_line
                    signature_last_line = [signature_last_line, nested_last_line].max
                    window_end = [window_end, nested_last_line].max
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end

          if method_body
            body_range = method_body.source_range
            if body_range
              body_first_line = body_range.first_line
              body_last_line = body_range.last_line
              body_span = body_last_line - body_first_line
              body_span_end = body_first_line + body_span
              window_start = [window_start, body_first_line].min
              window_end = [window_end, body_span_end].max

              case method_body.type
              when :begin, :kwbegin
                first_child = method_body.children.first
                last_child = method_body.children.last
                if first_child
                  first_child_line = first_child.first_line
                  window_start = [window_start, first_child_line].min
                end
                if last_child
                  last_child_line = last_child.last_line
                  window_end = [window_end, last_child_line].max
                end
              when :if
                if_branch = method_body.if_branch
                else_branch = method_body.else_branch
                if if_branch
                  if_branch_line = if_branch.last_line
                  window_end = [window_end, if_branch_line].max
                end
                if else_branch
                  else_branch_line = else_branch.last_line
                  window_end = [window_end, else_branch_line].max
                end
              when :send, :csend
                receiver_node = method_body.receiver
                if receiver_node
                  receiver_line = receiver_node.first_line
                  window_start = [window_start, receiver_line].min
                end
                send_last_line = method_body.last_line
                window_end = [window_end, send_last_line].max
              else
                other_last_line = method_body.last_line
                window_end = [window_end, other_last_line].max
              end
            end
          end

          combined_end = signature_last_line
          combined_end = last_line if last_line > combined_end
          window_end = combined_end if combined_end > window_end
          window_start = first_line if first_line < window_start
          window_start = 1 if window_start.negative?

          cached_lines = {}
          cached_lengths = {}
          current_line_number = window_start
          while current_line_number <= window_end
            line_index = current_line_number - 1
            if line_index >= 0
              if line_index < source_lines.length
                line_text = source_lines[line_index]
                cached_lines[current_line_number] = line_text
                line_length = 0
                line_length = line_text.length unless line_text.nil?
                cached_lengths[current_line_number] = line_length
              end
            end
            current_line_number += 1
          end

          beginning_index = first_line
          if beginning_index >= 0
            if beginning_index < source_lines.length
              beginning_text = cached_lines[beginning_index + 1]
              beginning_text = source_lines[beginning_index] if beginning_text.nil?
              if beginning_text
                if beginning_text.empty?
                  source_buffer = investigation.buffer
                  if source_buffer
                    offense_line_number = beginning_index + 1
                    line_range_obj = source_buffer.line_range(offense_line_number)
                    if line_range_obj
                      column_index = 0
                      line_begin_pos = line_range_obj.begin_pos
                      begin_pos = line_begin_pos + column_index
                      end_pos = begin_pos + 1
                      offense_range = source_range(source_buffer, offense_line_number, column_index)
                      cached_length = cached_lengths[offense_line_number]
                      cached_length = 0 if cached_length.nil?
                      if offense_range && offense_range.begin_pos == begin_pos && offense_range.end_pos == end_pos && cached_length.zero?
                        location_name = 'beginning'
                        beginning_message = message(MSG_EXTRA, location_name)
                        offense_style = :no_empty_lines
                        add_offense(offense_range, message: beginning_message) do |corrector|
                          EmptyLineCorrector.correct(corrector, [offense_style, offense_range])
                        end
                      end
                    end
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end

          ending_index = last_line - 2
          if ending_index >= 0
            if ending_index < source_lines.length
              ending_text = cached_lines[ending_index + 1]
              ending_text = source_lines[ending_index] if ending_text.nil?
              if ending_text
                if ending_text.empty?
                  source_buffer = investigation.buffer
                  if source_buffer
                    offense_line_number = ending_index + 1
                    line_range_obj = source_buffer.line_range(offense_line_number)
                    if line_range_obj
                      column_index = 0
                      line_begin_pos = line_range_obj.begin_pos
                      begin_pos = line_begin_pos + column_index
                      end_pos = begin_pos + 1
                      offense_range = source_range(source_buffer, offense_line_number, column_index)
                      cached_length = cached_lengths[offense_line_number]
                      cached_length = 0 if cached_length.nil?
                      if offense_range && offense_range.begin_pos == begin_pos && offense_range.end_pos == end_pos && cached_length.zero?
                        location_name = 'end'
                        ending_message = message(MSG_EXTRA, location_name)
                        offense_style = :no_empty_lines
                        add_offense(offense_range, message: ending_message) do |corrector|
                          EmptyLineCorrector.correct(corrector, [offense_style, offense_range])
                        end
                      end
                    end
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
        alias on_defs on_def

        private

        def style
          :no_empty_lines
        end
      end
    end
  end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Layout
      # Common functionality for checking if presence/absence of empty lines
      # around some kind of body matches the configuration.
      module EmptyLinesAroundBody
        extend NodePattern::Macros
        include ConfigurableEnforcedStyle
        include RangeHelp

        MSG_EXTRA = 'Extra empty line detected at %<kind>s body %<location>s.'
        MSG_MISSING = 'Empty line missing at %<kind>s body %<location>s.'
        MSG_DEFERRED = 'Empty line missing before first %<type>s definition'

        private

        # @!method constant_definition?(node)
        def_node_matcher :constant_definition?, '{class module}'

        # @!method empty_line_required?(node)
        def_node_matcher :empty_line_required?,
                         '{def defs class module (send nil? {:private :protected :public})}'

        def check(node, body, adjusted_first_line: nil)
          return if valid_body_style?(body)
          return if node.single_line?

          first_line = adjusted_first_line || node.source_range.first_line
          last_line = node.source_range.last_line

          case style
          when :empty_lines_except_namespace
            check_empty_lines_except_namespace(body, first_line, last_line)
          when :empty_lines_special
            check_empty_lines_special(body, first_line, last_line)
          else
            check_both(style, first_line, last_line)
          end
        end

        def check_empty_lines_except_namespace(body, first_line, last_line)
          if namespace?(body, with_one_child: true)
            check_both(:no_empty_lines, first_line, last_line)
          else
            check_both(:empty_lines, first_line, last_line)
          end
        end

        def check_empty_lines_special(body, first_line, last_line)
          return unless body

          if namespace?(body, with_one_child: true)
            check_both(:no_empty_lines, first_line, last_line)
          else
            if first_child_requires_empty_line?(body)
              check_beginning(:empty_lines, first_line)
            else
              check_beginning(:no_empty_lines, first_line)
              check_deferred_empty_line(body)
            end
            check_ending(:empty_lines, last_line)
          end
        end

        def check_both(style, first_line, last_line)
          case style
          when :beginning_only
            check_beginning(:empty_lines, first_line)
            check_ending(:no_empty_lines, last_line)
          when :ending_only
            check_beginning(:no_empty_lines, first_line)
            check_ending(:empty_lines, last_line)
          else
            check_beginning(style, first_line)
            check_ending(style, last_line)
          end
        end

        def check_beginning(style, first_line)
          check_source(style, first_line, 'beginning')
        end

        def check_ending(style, last_line)
          check_source(style, last_line - 2, 'end')
        end

        def check_source(style, line_no, desc)
          case style
          when :no_empty_lines
            check_line(style, line_no, message(MSG_EXTRA, desc), &:empty?)
          when :empty_lines
            check_line(style, line_no, message(MSG_MISSING, desc)) { |line| !line.empty? }
          end
        end

        def check_line(style, line, msg)
          return unless yield(processed_source.lines[line])

          offset = style == :empty_lines && msg.include?('end.') ? 2 : 1
          range = source_range(processed_source.buffer, line + offset, 0)
          add_offense(range, message: msg) do |corrector|
            EmptyLineCorrector.correct(corrector, [style, range])
          end
        end

        def check_deferred_empty_line(body)
          node = first_empty_line_required_child(body)
          return unless node

          line = previous_line_ignoring_comments(node.first_line)
          return if processed_source[line].empty?

          range = source_range(processed_source.buffer, line + 2, 0)

          add_offense(range, message: deferred_message(node)) do |corrector|
            EmptyLineCorrector.correct(corrector, [:empty_lines, range])
          end
        end

        def namespace?(body, with_one_child: false)
          if body.begin_type?
            return false if with_one_child

            body.children.all? { |child| constant_definition?(child) }
          else
            constant_definition?(body)
          end
        end

        def first_child_requires_empty_line?(body)
          if body.begin_type?
            empty_line_required?(body.children.first)
          else
            empty_line_required?(body)
          end
        end

        def first_empty_line_required_child(body)
          if body.begin_type?
            body.children.find { |child| empty_line_required?(child) }
          elsif empty_line_required?(body)
            body
          end
        end

        def previous_line_ignoring_comments(send_line)
          (send_line - 2).downto(0) do |line|
            return line unless comment_line?(processed_source[line])
          end
          0
        end

        def message(type, desc)
          format(type, kind: self.class::KIND, location: desc)
        end

        def deferred_message(node)
          format(MSG_DEFERRED, type: node.type)
        end

        def valid_body_style?(body)
          # When style is `empty_lines`, if the body is empty, we don't enforce
          # the presence OR absence of an empty line
          # But if style is `no_empty_lines`, there must not be an empty line
          body.nil? && style != :no_empty_lines
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Layout
      # Checks if empty lines around the bodies of classes match
      # the configuration.
      #
      # @example EnforcedStyle: no_empty_lines (default)
      #   # good
      #
      #   class Foo
      #     def bar
      #       # ...
      #     end
      #   end
      #
      # @example EnforcedStyle: empty_lines
      #   # good
      #
      #   class Foo
      #
      #     def bar
      #       # ...
      #     end
      #
      #   end
      #
      # @example EnforcedStyle: empty_lines_except_namespace
      #   # good
      #
      #   class Foo
      #     class Bar
      #
      #       # ...
      #
      #     end
      #   end
      #
      # @example EnforcedStyle: empty_lines_special
      #   # good
      #   class Foo
      #
      #     def bar; end
      #
      #   end
      #
      # @example EnforcedStyle: beginning_only
      #   # good
      #
      #   class Foo
      #
      #     def bar
      #       # ...
      #     end
      #   end
      #
      # @example EnforcedStyle: ending_only
      #   # good
      #
      #   class Foo
      #     def bar
      #       # ...
      #     end
      #
      #   end
      class EmptyLinesAroundClassBody < Base
        include EmptyLinesAroundBody
        extend AutoCorrector

        KIND = 'class'

        def on_class(node)
          first_line = node.parent_class.first_line if node.parent_class

          check(node, node.body, adjusted_first_line: first_line)
        end

        def on_sclass(node)
          check(node, node.body)
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
